## Summary

Addresses the two open PRs with the most unresolved review threads (#105 with 10 and #109 with 15). All 25 flagged issues fall into five categories resolved below.

### PromptCompilerSeam (`src/lib/seams/prompt-compiler-seam/`)

- **mock.ts** — Replace 87-line logic-heavy mock that duplicated prompt-building logic with a 3-line scenario-based fixture loader. Add `_input` parameter to `compile` (copilot P2 thread on #105). Return `structuredClone(...)` per call to prevent cross-test fixture mutation (copilot P2 thread on #109).
- **fixtures.ts** — Add `promptCompilerInputFaultFixture` and `compiledPromptFaultFixture` both typed as `unknown` (not cast to concrete types at export site). Add `getCompiledPromptFixture()` helper that confines the unavoidable `CompiledPrompt` cast to a single boundary (addresses copilot "fault fixtures typed as unknown" thread on #109).
- **test.ts** — Add fault-scenario test with no `as never` cast (addresses CodeRabbit/gemini/copilot threads on #105). Add validator-rejection tests for both fault fixtures.

### GalleryStoreSeam (`src/lib/seams/gallery-store-seam/`)

- **mock.ts** — Remove `initialRecords` parameter (replace with empty in-memory array). Fix misleading header comment: "seeded from fixtures" → "in-memory state", remove "→ fixtures" from info flow (addresses copilot thread on #105, gemini thread on #109).
- **fixtures.ts** — Add `galleryRecordFaultFixture` typed as `unknown` (addresses copilot/sourcery threads on #105).
- **test.ts** — Upgrade `listRecent` limit test to assert ordering `['r3', 'r2']`, not just length (addresses gemini, sourcery-ai, copilot threads on #105/#109). Add instance-isolation test and validator-rejection test.

### DECISIONS.md

Add 2026-05-30 Cipher Gate entry documenting the seam mock refactor per governance requirements (addresses chatgpt-codex-connector thread on #109).

## Test plan

- [x] All 425 existing tests continue to pass (`npx vitest run`)
- [x] 4 new `PromptCompilerSeam` tests pass (sample, fault scenario, two validator-rejection tests)
- [x] 4 new `GalleryStoreSeam` tests pass (existing + limit+ordering, isolation, validator-rejection)
- [x] TypeScript strict mode: no `as never` casts, fault fixtures exported as `unknown`

## Code Review

This pull request refactors the mocks for PromptCompilerSeam and GalleryStoreSeam to use scenario-based fixtures instead of logic-heavy implementations, aligning with SDD Core Principle #2. It introduces intentionally invalid fault fixtures typed as unknown to verify validator rejections and ensures better test isolation. However, the createMockGalleryStoreSeam mock remains vulnerable to fixture mutation risks because it stores and returns references to the same GalleryRecord objects without deep cloning. It is recommended to use structuredClone when saving and listing records to prevent cross-test contamination.
